prompt_md: A 10 litre jug is full of juice. You pour out 1 litre, top it up with water and stir. You do this 3 times in all. What percent of the jug is juice now?
prompt_short: 10 L of juice: swap 1 L for water, 3 times. Percent juice left?
hint_md: The second litre you pour out isn't pure juice.
explain_intuition_md: Only the first litre poured out is pure juice. Each later pour takes some water with it, so you lose less than a litre of juice each time.
explain_math_md: Each round keeps $90\%$ of the juice: $0.9^3 = 0.729 = 72.9\%$.
